response.sql: WITH film_copies AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) as copy_count FROM film f LEFT JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating), rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(copy_count) as avg_copies_by_rating FROM film_copies GROUP BY rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(copy_count) as avg_copies_overall FROM film_copies) SELECT fc.film_id, fc.rating, fc.copy_count, fc.copy_count - ra.avg_copies_by_rating as diff_from_rating_avg, fc.copy_count - oa.avg_copies_overall as diff_from_overall_avg FROM film_copies fc JOIN rating_averages ra ON fc.rating = ra.rating CROSS JOIN overall_average oa ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10
